_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With BTC flat over 30 days, funding neutral, no marginal buyer and no forced seller, the coil has no breaker visible enough to justify a directional call against a 97% base rate of sideways movement.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both agree on HOLD/sideways, but the analyst forward-calls Disbelief (up 1 rung) while the narrative stays anchored in Denial; the split is on whether recovery begins now or stays coiled
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive (>20) AND stablecoin growth recovers (>45) with BTC momentum pushing >60
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes >75 with DXY breaking >101 AND funding flipping negative
